crossRefs.note: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of…
In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian…
It will happen in that day that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and…
It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of…
They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them…
A day to build your walls— In that day, he will extend your boundary.
In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea…
For Yahweh says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I…
“The east side, between Hauran and Damascus and Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north…
The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and…
Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest, in the middle of…
“For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now that land will be…
“Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare: lengthen your…
For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in…
The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, Yahweh, will do this quickly in its time.”

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.
translations.bsb: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon until no more room is found for them.
translations.kjv: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found
translations.asv: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
